verdict.rationale: Claude Design connects to live data sources such as GitHub, local codebases, Salesforce and HubSpot, so asking whether it offers a sandbox environment isolated from production data is a fair question. The evidence pack documents no sandbox, test mode, or isolated environment. Interactive prototypes for user-testing are a different feature and do not provide data isolation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
